# DropSpace 1.2.1

<!-- update-summary: Fixes the music spectrum disappearing during playback or after resuming when the player uses multiple processes. -->

## Since 1.2.0

- Fixed an intermittent loss of the audio meter with multi-process players, including NetEase Cloud Music. Capture follows the player’s process tree even when its main window is hidden.
- The compact Island, expanded Island, Music page and independent music window retain an established meter during a temporary capture interruption. The bars settle to silence and resume moving when audio returns.

## Windows downloads

Windows x64 build 20348 or later. Choose the per-user installer, portable executable or MSIX package. The Windows packages are unsigned. SHA-256 checksums are included with the release. Portable updates use manual replacement.

v1.2.0 is the immediate upgrade baseline and previous Stable release.
